units.source_text: 夏日，某个艳阳高照的正午，阿住和邻居家的阿婆正在仓库前面爬满葡萄叶的棚架下聊天。

en.t: On a summer day, at a certain bright, sunlit noon, Azumi and the old woman from next door were chatting under the grape-leaf trellis in front of the storehouse.

units.source_text: 除了牛棚里苍蝇的嗡嗡声，周围格外安静。

en.t: Except for the buzzing of flies in the cowshed, everything around them was unusually quiet.

units.source_text: 邻居家阿婆一边聊天，一边吸着短烟卷——那是她儿子没吸完的烟蒂，她仔细收集的。

en.t: As the old woman from next door chatted, she smoked a short cigarette, a butt her son had not finished and that she had carefully saved.
